text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup—
Satono Diamond takes on the challenge in the very race Tokai Teio declared she would enter.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I really didn't expect Dia-chan
to enter the race too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Why?
Teio-san is someone
I want to surpass, too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're McQueen-san's special rival.
Of course I'd want to race you too, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true too!
After all, you've seen how strong Teio-san is right alongside me, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there was something
I wanted to learn from Teio-san."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to witness how Teio-san carries herself
as a 'renowned Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't really understand it, but
Dia-chan must have her own reasons for it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still! Teio-san is the one
I've looked up to all this time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I will NEVER let this victory go! I'm the one who's gonna beat Teio!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'll beat both Kita-chan and Teio-san,
and become a truly legendary Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you two have gotten super strong, but Lady Tokai Teio is way stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll show you just how strong I am!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, Dia-chan!
Come at me with everything you've got!!
